trial_title: OSI-774 (Tarceva) in Treating Patients With Stage III or Stage IV Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine if OSI-774 will improve overall survival of patients with incurable stage IIIB/IV non-small cell lung cancer compared to standard of care. OSI-774 is a new type of drug under evaluation called an epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR). OSI-774 is an investigational drug that has not yet been approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA).

eligibility_table.criterion: Clinical diagnosis of stage IIIB or IV non-small cell lung cancer.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a confirmed clinical diagnosis of stage IIIB or IV non-small cell lung cancer based on imaging and histopathological evaluation?

eligibility_table.criterion: Must have evidence of disease (clinical or radiological).
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has systemic mastocytosis, which is a recognized disease, indicating evidence of disease.

eligibility_table.criterion: Have failed 1 but no more than 2 prior chemotherapy regimens, have recovered from any side effects and have not had any chemotherapy for at least 21 days.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has not undergone any chemotherapy regimens, as indicated by the prior treatments listed.

eligibility_table.criterion: If the patient has had surgery, the surgery was at least 2 weeks ago.
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided about any recent surgeries, making it unclear if this criterion is met.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient undergone surgery for non-small cell lung cancer at least 2 weeks prior to enrollment in the trial?

eligibility_table.criterion: Patients whose cancer has spread to their brain or central nervous system are eligible, providing that they have been on stable dose of steroids for at least 4 weeks and are free of symptoms.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is on a steroid taper and has not been on a stable dose of steroids for at least 4 weeks.

eligibility_table.criterion: If the patient received radiation therapy, treatment was at least 4 weeks ago.
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided regarding any prior radiation therapy, making it unclear if this criterion is met.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient received radiation therapy within the last 4 weeks?
